compute_llvm_observation_from_bitcode: compute an LLVM observation from a bitcode file using a standalone C++ binary without initializing a full environment
convert_pascal_case_to_enum: convert a PascalCase string to ENUM_CASE format for observation space naming
compute_observation_with_timeout: compute an LLVM observation from bitcode with a configurable timeout to prevent long-running processes
parse_protobuf_observation_event: parse a protobuf text format stdout response into an Event object and translate it via the observation space spec
validate_bitcode_file_exists: validate that a given LLVM bitcode file path exists before attempting to compute an observation
